hints.title: Two Balanced Partitions
hints.text: Split the structure into two halves: left and right double-ended sequences. The middle element resides at the boundary between them.

hints.title: Maintaining Size Invariant
hints.text: Keep the two deques balanced such that len(left) == len(right) or len(right) == len(left) + 1.

hints.title: Constant-Time Middle Operations
hints.text: Middle push and pop operate directly on right.popleft() or left.pop() followed by a rebalancing step.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: number of elements in queue
complexity.notes: Every insertion, deletion, and middle access executes in O(1) time using two balanced deques.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: A single contiguous list takes O(N) time for middle insertions and deletions.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Dual-deque splitting achieves worst-case O(1) time with minimal pointer overhead.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Two-deque balancing maintaining strict size invariants.

solutions.approach: Dual Deques with Strict Size Invariant
